title: Retained Connection Object Protocol
branch_reset: from regression target fitting to retained connection identity testing
core_statement: The missing bridge is not a better holonomy scalar. It is the correct retained curvature object of a generated-algebra connection, plus a source-balanced compatibility identity.

local_generated_algebra.symbol: G_p = <B_p, O3_p, H4_perp_p, S_p, Pi_p, op_plus_p>
local_generated_algebra.principle: G_p is not just a vector space; it is a generated retained recombination algebra with provenance order.

required_faithfulness_conditions: product faithfulness: T_pq(x op_plus_p y) ≈ T_pq(x) op_plus_q T_pq(y)
source/provenance faithfulness: T_pq(Pi_p) respects pruning-order dependencies in Pi_q
order-arrow faithfulness: T_pq must not reverse admissible retained-order direction
inadmissible: branch-only transport when product/O3/H4 preservation fails
scalar holonomy as primary curvature object

curvature_object.loop_transport: Omega_C,p0 = T_pn,p0 o ... o T_p1,p2 o T_p0,p1
curvature_object.reason: Curvature must be considered modulo admissible generated-algebra automorphisms, not arbitrary vector frame rotations.

covariant_comparison.problem: R_i and R_j live in End(G_i) and End(G_j), so raw subtraction is invalid.
covariant_comparison.comparison: Comp_{j->i}(R_j), defined by admissible retained transport
covariant_comparison.directed_case: Comp_{j->i}(R_j) = Pi_i o T_{j->i} o R_j o T_{i->j}^{admissible}

source_balanced_identity.J_P: provenance/source/pruning-order current across the comparison boundary
source_balanced_identity.principle: A retained recombination system is not assumed source-free; source-balanced closure precedes source-free closure.

killer_null.name: N_alg_shuffle
killer_null.pass_condition: valid Gamma_R gives small/structured/convergent ||D_Gamma R_Gamma - J_P|| while N_alg_shuffle fails despite preserved surface statistics
killer_null.kill_condition: if N_alg_shuffle also satisfies the identity, the identity is construction artifact rather than retained connection law

governance_freeze: generic scalar holonomy is diagnostic only
toy weak_target is banned as law evidence
construction recovery is not law discovery
no regression rescue without a first-principles identity
next_allowed_execution: Only after a concrete Gamma_R emitter produces G_p objects, admissible T_pq faithfulness defects, R_Gamma loop endomorphisms, J_P currents, and N_alg_shuffle nulls.
